classes.purpose: Per-activity-level entrust (commission) reward/config, indexed via the CLevelEnGroupInfo level grid. Provides a level-based lookup used to enumerate entrust entries for an activity level.

methods.purpose: Static singleton accessor for the class CInfoManager.
Thin accessor returning the singleton instance pointer.

Lookup: resolves an activity level (param_1) against the CLevelEnGroupInfo 2D grid (base at +0x30, columns at +0x28, count at +0x24, row-array at +0x20), validates the target entry has a non-zero list at +0x2c, then iterates this class's own managers to collect matching entrust entries. Calls FUN_11548ea0(level).

formulas: CLevelEnGroupInfo grid index: idx = level - base(+0x30); row = idx / cols(+0x28); col = idx % cols; entry = grid[+0x20][row][col]; valid iff 0 <= idx < count(+0x24) and entry->+0x2c != 0
classes.notes: The 2D-grid layout (+0x20 row-array, +0x24 count, +0x28 columns, +0x30 base) is the shared CInfoManager/CLevelEnGroupInfo container layout, not fields of the entrust element itself. Entrust TLV docs exist but describe group stats; treat mapping as directional.

classes.purpose: Star-stone (gem) level-up EXP curve. Each level row stores five threshold/attribute values; provides a GetLevelByExp that maps accumulated EXP to a star-stone level by walking the curve.

methods.purpose: Static singleton accessor for the class CInfoManager.
Thin accessor returning the singleton instance pointer.

Given (param_1 = attribute/column index 0-4, param_2 = current EXP), iterates levels from 1..maxLevel (max from FUN_1183eca0 struct +0x34), reads the level row's threshold at the selected column, and returns the last level whose threshold is <= the given EXP. Returns -1/curve edge cases handled.

fields.name: attrExpCol0
fields.note: level-row column selected by attr index 0 (the default/primary EXP threshold)

formulas: GetLevelByExp(attr, exp): for L in 1..maxLevel: threshold = row(L)->col[attr]; if exp < threshold return L-1 (previous level); returns maxLevel when exp exceeds all thresholds. Level->row resolved via the manager 2D grid (base +0x30, cols +0x28, count +0x24, row-array +0x20).
classes.notes: Element field offsets (+0x14..+0x24) are confirmed from the switch in GetLevelByExp. The +0x20/+0x24/+0x28/+0x30 grid offsets belong to the shared CInfoManager container. No exact StarStone TLV doc found.

notes: Batch-wide finding: all 37 bundles were auto-labelled 'GetManagers' but are actually the shared CInfoManager singleton/factory-registration template (StcMbrNameSvr<CInfoManager> named factory via FUN_11679e10; static-init flag-guarded lazy construction; iterator loops that precache child elements). Method-1 of each class = GetInfoManager (factory accessor), and where present a single-int-param variant = GetInfoManagerInstance. No DebugFormat printer, no XML/_PreCache loader, and no TLV tag>>4 reader survived in any bundle, so per-class field layouts are almost entirely unrecoverable here. Exceptions with genuine field/logic content: CStarStoneLevelExpInfo (GetLevelByExp EXP->level curve, element fields +0x14..+0x24), CStarStoneTinyInfo (QueryAttrFromInstance, same grid + descriptor scan on 0x114-byte records tagged 0xbdb), and CActivityLevelEntrustInfo (GetEntrustByActivityLevel using the CLevelEnGroupInfo 2D level grid). Confirmed containment cross-references: CGiftBagGroupInfo->CGiftBagInfo, CMonsterGroupInfo->CMonsterInfo, CSoulStoneStageUpInfo->CSoulStoneAttrInfo, CDailyFramAwardInfo->CItemBoxGroupInfo, CCorFuliConfigInfo->CVIPServiceInfo, CActivityLevelEntrustInfo->CLevelEnGroupInfo. The shared CInfoManager container grid layout is +0x20 row-pointer-array, +0x24 total count, +0x28 columns/stride, +0x30 base index.
